recent: UEMS 与 AME Elite 组成联营公司，在 Gerbang Nusajaya 开发综合工业园，并拟出售约 402.106 英亩土地；同时宣布每股 1.53 仙特别股息。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收与净利均较上季及去年同期增长。
notable: 与 AME Development 成立 50:50 联营公司，开发综合工业园，并拟以 RM972.1 million 出售约 402.106 英亩土地。
宣布 2026 财年每股 1.53 仙特别股息。
与 EXSIM KL City Centre 的发展权协议下，RM415.0 million 保证权益已全数收取。
earnings: 2026-06-30 季度营收 RM605.7 million，环比增 74.2%，同比增 36.9%；净利 RM46.8 million，环比增 189.1%，同比增 109.0%；净利率 7.7%，高于上季的 4.7%。

recent_en: UEMS formed a joint venture with AME Elite to develop an integrated industrial park in Gerbang Nusajaya and proposed disposal of approximately 402.106 acres of land; it also declared a special dividend of 1.53 sen per share. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue and net profit grew both QoQ and YoY.
notable_en: Formed a 50:50 joint venture with AME Development to develop an integrated industrial park and proposed disposal of approximately 402.106 acres of land for RM972.1 million.
Declared a special dividend of 1.53 sen per share for FY2026.
Received the full RM415.0 million guaranteed entitlement under the development rights agreement with EXSIM KL City Centre.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was RM605.7 million, up 74.2% QoQ and 36.9% YoY; net profit was RM46.8 million, up 189.1% QoQ and 109.0% YoY; net margin was 7.7%, higher than 4.7% in the previous quarter.
